description: This file defines the LeaveRequestDecorator class, which provides additional methods for handling LeaveRequest entities, including setting related Employee and LeaveType entities and retrieving formatted date and last comment details.

classes.name: LeaveRequestDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class that extends the LeaveRequest entity with additional utility methods, such as setting related entities and retrieving formatted data.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the decorator with a LeaveRequest entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee associated with the leave request based on employee number.

methods.name: setLeaveTypeById
methods.description: Sets the LeaveType for the leave request based on leave type ID.

methods.name: getDateApplied
methods.description: Returns a formatted string of the date the leave request was applied for.

methods.name: getLastComment
methods.description: Retrieves the most recent comment on the leave request.
